definition: Each ecliptic quadrant ASC→IC→DSC→MC→ASC is divided into three equal ecliptic arcs.
hard_rules: ASC is cusp 1 and MC is cusp 10
DSC is ASC + 180 degrees and IC is MC + 180 degrees modulo 360
each quadrant is divided into three equal ecliptic arcs
exact cusp longitude belongs to the cusp house
invalid or degenerate angular geometry is rejected
Porphyry fallback from another house system must be explicit and never silent

reference.name: Swiss Ephemeris house-system documentation
reference.role: definition and Placidus polar-fallback reference only; runtime code does not depend on Swiss Ephemeris
